headline: Lagarde says her greatest concern is the AI-amplified cyber threat
summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde said the most immediate challenge facing finance could be cyber threats powered by increasingly sophisticated artificial intelligence agents.
why: The European Central Bank supervises major eurozone banks, and cyber resilience is a growing financial stability concern for regulators and investors.
original_headline: Lagarde dice que su mayor preocupación es la amenaza cibernética potenciada por la IA
